reason: Verify every implementation claim against AC1-AC44, especially real-data visibility, fixed strategy order, adaptive SwiftUI Controllers Table, pause semantics, lifecycle, retry, buffers, and the Phase 4A user approval gate.

Audit source-order preservation, GLOBAL presentation-only handling, complete active UI data, structured errors, and export credential/raw-body exclusions.
Audit the final visual system against the maintained Rose Pine tokens, native macOS hierarchy, font-scale behavior, Reduce Transparency/Motion, contrast, and no-card-slop rules.
